target: Anna personalized meme editor: Reference Desk A

contract.purpose: Let people appear in a recognizable meme using a chosen photo, review the remix, and save or share it.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab turns one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.audience: People sharing personal reactions in group chats, plus the owner evaluating the Anna pilot.
contract.job: Upload a permitted static meme and photo, select the character, generate one personal version, and review before sharing.
contract.thesis: The original and personal version sit side by side in a restrained Reference Desk workspace.
contract.system: Inherited navy navigation, white surfaces, cobalt actions, compact native forms and modest corners; paired original/remix workspace and private image library.
contract.signature: A visible face-area selector on the original pairs with a private library of ready-to-share personal memes.
contract.risk: AI may change captions, expression or background; the comparison makes review explicit before sharing.

projectCheck.command: npm test; npm run check; anna-app validate --strict; git diff --check; hosted Anna editor verification

findings: Three static missing-src warnings are hidden dynamic photo/original/output images. Each remains hidden until its real source is assigned; no placeholder image is shown.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner explicitly selected A · Reference Desk for the personalized meme editor on 2026-10-02.
